messages:
kevin: Nimbus asked for a joint-architecture doc + quick telemetry plan before their exec demo. They want partner-scoped keys, SSO, and a clear note on what telemetry we surface to partners. Can we sketch this today?

sophie (NimbusPartner): Hi! For the demo we need: partner key TTLed 14 days, SAML SSO for two demo users, uptime target for the demo (can you confirm SLA for hosted pilot?), and a single page describing what logs/metrics Nimbus will see.

ali: Quick answers: partner keys with TTL 14d doable; SAML yes (we'll send SP metadata). Hosted pilot SLA: we can commit to 99.5% for short pilots with monitoring hooks; will confirm with SRE.

zara: Telemetry note: partners get usage aggregates (tokens, calls) and per-partner error rates. We do NOT expose raw customer prompts in partner portal; only anonymized metrics and error traces with PII redacted. Compliance team wants to review wording.

sophie (NimbusPartner): Great. Also the demo infra team requires stable hostnames for firewall allowlist (they won't accept CIDRs). Can you provide those?

kevin: Hostnames: api.redwood.ai, auth.redwood.ai, telemetry.redwood.ai. We'll call out that IPs may change; hostname allowlist recommended.

ali: On the architecture doc, should we propose a split traffic flow: partner requests -> our edge -> model pool? Also include optional proxying for dedicated tenants.

sophie (NimbusPartner): Yes, show both Hosted and Dedicated flows. Execs care about data isolation for production, but demo can be Hosted.

zara: I'll draft the joint-arch diagram text: 1) Nimbus UI -> 2) partner-scoped API key hits api.redwood.ai -> 3) routing layer (can route to Dedicated pool or hosted) -> 4) inference runtime -> 5) telemetry & logs exported (aggregates to partner portal + audit export).

kevin: Action items: 1) Draft joint-arch doc (zara) 2) Partner key provisioning guide + CLI (ali) 3) Telemetry wording for partner-facing doc (zara + compliance) 4) SLA note (kevin to confirm with SRE). ETA EOD.

ali: Draft CLI examples: 
```
# create partner entitlement and key (14d)
redwood-cli partner create-entitlement --partner nimbus --code ENT-NIM-DEMO --embeddings 50k/day --burst 100rps
redwood-cli partner create-key --entitlement ENT-NIM-DEMO --ttl 14d --label "nimbus-demo-14d"
```
Include note: keys are scoped to entitlement; partner portal shows usage aggregates only.

sophie (NimbusPartner): Will the partner key surface a partner_id tag in telemetry so Nimbus can break down usage per sales account?

zara: Yes, we'll include partner_id and entitlement code in telemetry. Example exported fields: partner_id, entitlement_code, date, svc_calls, tokens, error_rate. No prompt content.

compliance-bot: Reminder: for partner-facing telemetry language, include explicit statement about no training on partner data and log retention policy (90 days) per policy P-42.

zara: Good call. Wording draft for partner doc: "We provide aggregated usage and error metrics (partner_id, entitlement_code, calls, tokens, latency). We do not expose raw prompt/response content in the partner portal. Audit logs containing metadata may be exported on request; raw content is redacted. Logs retained 90 days for Hosted pilots."

kevin: SRE confirmed: we can offer 99.5% pilot uptime SLA for a 30-day pilot on Hosted with standard rate-limits; Dedicated tenants needed for higher SLA guarantees.

sophie (NimbusPartner): That's workable for the demo. Legal wants a one-page pilot addendum referencing SLA, log retention, and data usage (no training). Can you draft?

kevin: I'll draft the addendum and loop legal. One blocker: legal asks whether HSM is available for pilot keys. Short answer: HSM is Private-only; we'll say so in addendum.

ali: Also flagging ops requirement: partner-hosted webhooks need to be whitelisted; we should include webhook hostnames in the doc.

sophie (NimbusPartner): We'll provide webhook endpoints.

zara: Uploading draft joint-arch + telemetry wording to shared drive: https://redwood.shares/partners/nimbus/joint-arch-v1.pdf. Please review.

ops-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-9999 for key provisioning and hostname publish at 2133334600

kevin: Next sync tomorrow 11am PT to finalize addendum and provision keys. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
